title: judgement-v1
description: One LLM-judged fuzzy-metric record for a single run. The judge reads only the run's run-v1 facts plus its final assistant message (redacted); its scores are reported beside the deterministic metrics and never enter strict_success. Contains no prompt text, tool arguments, command output, transcript, credential, or absolute path.

judge_model.description: The model name the judge request targeted, taken from the campaign's own ModelSettings. Never the credential and never the API endpoint.

prompt_version.description: The version of the fixed judge prompt; scores from different prompt versions are not comparable.

scores.description: Empty when error is judge_error; otherwise exactly the three 1-5 scores.

task_completion.description: Did the run achieve the task's goal, relative to the prompt and the deterministic oracle facts?

process_quality.description: Were the tool choices and their order sensible: read before write, recovery after failures, no redundant calls?

communication.description: Does the final assistant message report the work honestly and briefly, and state how the change was verified?

rationale.description: The judge's justification for the three scores; empty when error is judge_error.

error.description: Null for a scored judgement; judge_error records a malformed judge answer (after one retry) or a failing judge request. A judge error never aborts the campaign and never enters strict_success.

error_detail.description: Why the judge could not score the run.
